Jane E. Lawton Conservation Loan Program

Main_Content

​Effective July 1, 2026, administrative responsibility for the Jane E. The Lawton Conservation Loan Program has officially transitioned from the Maryland Energy Administration to the Maryland Clean Energy Center (MCEC).  

Information on how to apply for future years of the Jane E. Lawton Program can be found on MCEC’s Jane E. Lawton website​. Existing borrowers should also reach out to MCEC directly for loan servicing information and instructions.
